visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of stat tiles: an oversized figure over a short label on a sand fill
visualCharacteristics.layout: Sand (#f9f2ec) tiles with 12px radius and 32px padding, 48px medium value over an 18px subdued label; all tiles in one row from 900px, two across from 600px, stacked on mobile.

contentPattern.structure: One row per stat. One cell: value paragraph (e.g. **4,100+**) then label paragraph. Or two cells: value | label.
contentPattern.notes: Stat values are not headings; keep them as paragraphs. Option small: text tiles; author a heading (H3) as the tile title and a paragraph as the description; a tile may hold only the description.

usage.description: Row of stat tiles with a large value and a label.

reuseGuidance: Use for key-figure rows. Use cards for image/text cards and cards-eyebrow for linked cards.
